# hosttracker_contact_group (Data Source)

Reads one contact group, by id or by the name it is known under.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By the name the group is known under. Group names are unique per
# account, so this resolves to one group or to none.
data "hosttracker_contact_group" "ops" {
  lookup_name = "Ops"
}

# By id.
data "hosttracker_contact_group" "by_id" {
  id = "7d1b3e55-2a90-4c11-8f36-4b1d2e6a9c83"
}

# `contact_ids` is the group's membership flattened, for wiring its
# contacts into subscriptions.
output "ops_members" {
  value = data.hosttracker_contact_group.ops.contact_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The group's id. Name it, or look the group up by `lookup_name`.
- `lookup_name` (String) Find the group by its name, matched exactly. Group names are unique per account, so this always resolves to one group or to none.

### Read-Only

- `contact_ids` (Set of String) The member contacts' ids, for wiring the group's contacts into other resources.
- `created` (Number) When the group was created, in Unix seconds.
- `items` (Attributes Set) The group's membership. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `name` (String) The group's name.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `contact_id` (String) The member contact's id.
- `events` (Set of String) What this membership subscribes the contact to.
